mapper.sql: merchant.id, merchant.owning_agent_id, merchant.merchant_no, merchant.merchant_type, merchant.legal_name, merchant.short_name, merchant.legal_representative_name, merchant.operator_user_id, operator_user.username AS operator_username, merchant.reviewer_user_id, reviewer_user.username AS reviewer_username, merchant.contact_name, merchant.contact_mobile_masked, merchant.reviewer_mobile_masked, merchant.industry, merchant.product_description, merchant.status, merchant.disabled_reason, merchant.certified_kyc_version_id, merchant.row_version, owning_agent.agent_no AS owning_agent_no, owning_agent.name AS owning_agent_name, merchant.create_time, merchant.update_time

FROM biz_merchant merchant LEFT JOIN sys_user operator_user ON operator_user.id = merchant.operator_user_id AND operator_user.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user reviewer_user ON reviewer_user.id = merchant.reviewer_user_id AND reviewer_user.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_agent owning_agent ON owning_agent.id = merchant.owning_agent_id AND owning_agent.tenant_id = merchant.tenant_id AND owning_agent.deleted = 0

sql.if: AND (operator_user.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.loginAccount}, '%') OR reviewer_user.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.loginAccount}, '%'))
AND (merchant.contact_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.contact}, '%') OR merchant.contact_mobile_masked LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.contact}, '%'))

if.test: query.channelCode != null or query.applicationStatuses.size() > 0 or query.applicationUpdatedTo != null

mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE merchant.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND merchant.deleted = 0
ORDER BY merchant.create_time DESC, merchant.id DESC
